scope: Rules about SELLING products online to the public (not about importing or posting them). Kept in a separate file next to paypal_country_rules_v1.json, which is pinned and covers import and export only. Only rules whose official page or document was read in full by the author on 2026-11-09 are listed; everything else is in docs/evidence/ONLINE_SALE_RULES_20261109.md under 'reported but not verified'.

rules.rule: Medical devices may be sold through distance-selling channels (including the internet) only by a registered medical device dealer or a pharmacy, and only class 1 devices and the 19 class 2 item groups listed in the annex; selling any other device this way is fined NT$30,000 to NT$1,000,000.
rules.statute: 醫療器材管理法 第十八條、第七十條
rules.instrument: 衛生福利部 公告 衛授食字第1101601942號 (2021-04-29, effective 2021-05-01)
rules.agency: Ministry of Health and Welfare, Food and Drug Administration
rules.read: announcement PDF and annex PDF read as images on 2026-11-09

rules.note: Contact lenses themselves are not on the annex (only lens care products). Marketplaces can be stricter than the law: Yahoo Taiwan's auction policy bans all medical devices.

rules.rule: A medical device registered with the Medical Device Authority may be sold online, but professional-use devices must not be sold to the general public; advertising needs the manufacturer's authorisation and an approval number.
rules.statute_en: Medical Device Authority, frequently asked questions
rules.note: An FAQ answer, not a statute; the page does not say which devices count as professional use.

marketplace_policies.rule: All medical devices are prohibited, even for licensed sellers; examples include blood pressure monitors, thermometers, contact lens solutions and cases, body fat meters, canes and walkers, wheelchairs.
Highly controlled medical devices, including contact lenses, are prohibited listings.
marketplace_policies.page_date: 2026-10-28 (as summarised by the reader, not verbatim)

marketplace_policies.rule: Prescription-required devices (for example contact lenses, CPAP, prescription hearing aids, TENS units needing a prescription) are prohibited; over-the-counter devices are allowed with conditions.
